attr.title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
attr.desc: Native AArch64 Linux port of the Android game library.
attr.inst: Requires the user's official arm64-v8a GSG Android package v2.11.311. Use the GTAExtractor helper app (https://github.com/RyouVC/GTAExtractor/) to extract libGame.so and the Play Asset Delivery assets, then place the generated files in ports/gtasa/gtasa/. This download contains only the Linux port runtime and does not include proprietary game data.
